```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)

library(vroom)
library(ggeffects)
library(lmTest)

all_colors <- viridis::viridis(10, option = "mako")
my_colors <- all_colors[c(3, 5, 7)]  # Selecting specific colors from the palette
```

# Load Pythia data

## Load induction heads

```{r include=FALSE}
## setwd("/Users/seantrott/Dropbox/UCSD/Research/NLMs/epistemology/mechinterp_generalizability/src/analysis")
directory_path <- "../../data/processed/induction_results/"
csv_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
length(csv_files)
csv_list <- csv_files %>%
  map(~ read_csv(.))


df_pythia_models <- bind_rows(csv_list) %>%
  mutate(model = sub("^EleutherAI/", "", mpath))  %>%
  mutate(step_modded = step + 1) %>%
  mutate(layer = layer + 1)
nrow(df_pythia_models)


table(df_pythia_models$seed)
table(df_pythia_models$mpath)



### Create head-level summaries
df_pythia_models_head_summaries_induction = df_pythia_models %>%
  group_by(mpath, n_params, step, step_modded, seed, model,
           layer, head) %>%
  summarise(mean_ps = mean(ps),
            mean_ar_acc = mean(ar_acc),
            mean_ar_rank = mean(ar_mean_rank)) %>%
  mutate(seed_name = paste0("seed", seed))


```

## Load 1-back

```{r include=FALSE}
## setwd("/Users/seantrott/Dropbox/UCSD/Research/NLMs/epistemology/mechinterp_generalizability/src/analysis")
directory_path <- "../../data/processed/attention_summaries/"
csv_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
length(csv_files)
csv_list <- csv_files %>%
  map(~ read_csv(.))


df_pythia_models_1back <- bind_rows(csv_list) %>%
  mutate(model = sub("^EleutherAI/", "", mpath)) %>%
  filter(Layer > 0)
nrow(df_pythia_models_1back)


table(df_pythia_models_1back$seed)
table(df_pythia_models_1back$mpath)
max(df_pythia_models_1back$step_modded)



```




# Analysis

## Positional analysis



## Compare to 1-back head positions

```{r}
### Induction heads
df_by_head_seed_induction = df_pythia_models_head_summaries_induction %>%
  filter(step_modded == 143001) %>%
  group_by(mpath) %>%
  mutate(z_ps = scale(mean_ps))


### 1-back heads
df_by_head_seed_1back = df_pythia_models_1back %>%
  filter(step_modded == 143001) %>%
  group_by(mpath) %>%
  mutate(z_mean_1back = scale(mean_1back))


# Get layer of max induction head per seed
induction_peaks <- df_by_head_seed_induction %>%
  filter(step == 143000) %>%
  group_by(model, seed_name) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps, n = 1) %>%
  select(model, seed_name, layer_induction = layer)

# Get layer of max 1-back head per seed
oneback_peaks <- df_by_head_seed_1back %>%
  filter(step_modded == 143001) %>%
  group_by(model, seed_name) %>%
  slice_max(mean_1back, n = 1) %>%
  select(model, seed_name, layer_1back = Layer)

# Join and compute offset
offsets <- induction_peaks %>%
  inner_join(oneback_peaks, by = c("model", "seed_name")) %>%
  mutate(offset = layer_induction - layer_1back)

mean(offsets$offset)
median(offsets$offset)
sd(offsets$offset)


### What is distribution of offsets by model?
offsets %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_offset = mean(offset),
    median_offset = median(offset),
    sd_offset = sd(offset),
    n = n()
  )

```

## Revised positional analysis

```{r position_revised}
make_long <- function(head_df, oneback_df, suite_name) {
  ps <- head_df %>% transmute(suite = suite_name, model, seed_name, n_params,
                              layer, head, metric = "Prefix-matching (PS)", value = mean_ps)
  ob <- oneback_df %>% transmute(suite = suite_name, model, seed_name, n_params,
                                 layer, head, metric = "1-back", value = mean_1back)
  bind_rows(ps, ob)
}

df_pythia_seed_1back_summaries <- df_pythia_models_1back %>%
  filter(step_modded == 143001) %>%
  mutate(head = Head - 1, layer = Layer) %>%
  filter(Layer > 0) %>%
  group_by(mpath, model, n_params, seed, seed_name, layer, head) %>%
  summarise(mean_1back = mean(mean_1back), mean_first = mean(mean_first), .groups = "drop")


df_pythia_induction_summaries_final = df_pythia_models_head_summaries_induction %>%
   filter(step_modded == 143001)


df_long_all <- bind_rows(
  make_long(df_pythia_induction_summaries_final, df_pythia_seed_1back_summaries, "Pythia")) %>%
  group_by(suite, model, seed_name, metric) %>%
  mutate(max_layer = max(layer), prop_layer = layer / max_layer) %>%
  ungroup()

df_long_all %>%
  group_by(suite, model, seed_name, metric, prop_layer) %>%
  summarise(val = max(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(bin = cut(prop_layer, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE),
         bin_mid = as.numeric(sub("[\\(\\[]([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", bin)) + 0.05) %>%
  group_by(metric, suite, bin_mid) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(val), se = sd(val) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bin_mid, y = mean_val, color = metric, fill = metric)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_val - se, ymax = mean_val + se), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~metric + suite, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Layer depth", y = "Mean of per-network max", color = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

mod_full = lmer(data = df_long_all,
                     value ~ metric * prop_layer + log10(max_layer) * prop_layer + 
                       metric * log10(max_layer) +
                       (1|seed_name) + (1|model))
summary(mod_full)


```


## Temporal coordination

```{r temporal_coordination}

df_by_head_max_attention_1back = df_pythia_models_1back %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded, seed, seed_name) %>%
  slice_max(mean_1back)

df_by_head_max_attention_induction = df_pythia_models_head_summaries_induction %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded, seed, seed_name) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps)

induction_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_induction %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, seed_name, step_modded) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_ps), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "Induction (PS)")

oneback_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_1back %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, seed_name, step_modded) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_1back), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "1-back Attention")

combined <- bind_rows(induction_traj, oneback_traj)

combined_avg <- combined %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded, metric) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(max_val), .groups = "drop")

# Plot
combined %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step_modded, y = max_val, 
             color = metric, group = interaction(seed_name, metric))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = combined_avg, 
            aes(x = step_modded, y = mean_val, color = metric, group = metric),
            linewidth = 1.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Training Step",
       y = "Max attention score",
       color = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1-back Attention" = "#E69F00", 
                                "Induction (PS)" = "#0072B2")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1.2) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, n_params))



```


### Analysis: expected onset step


```{r induction_1back_onsets_derivative}
df_dratio <- combined %>%
  group_by(model, seed_name, metric) %>%
  mutate(scaled = (max_val - min(max_val)) / (max(max_val) - min(max_val))) %>% 
  group_by(model, n_params, seed_name, metric) %>%
  arrange(step_modded, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(log_step = log10(step_modded),
         d_ratio  = c(NA, diff(max_val) / diff(log_step))) %>%
  ungroup()


onset_at_deriv <- function(df, T) {
  df %>% filter(d_ratio > T) %>%
    group_by(model, n_params, seed_name, metric) %>%
    slice_min(step_modded, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
    transmute(model, n_params, seed_name, metric, onset_step = step_modded, threshold = T)
}
deriv_sweep <- map_dfr(seq(0.01, 0.3, by = 0.01), ~ onset_at_deriv(df_dratio, .x))



### Now average across ratios
df_onset_long = deriv_sweep %>% 
  group_by(model, n_params, seed_name, metric) %>%
  summarise(m_onset = mean(onset_step - 1)) 


df_onset_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = metric,
             y = m_onset,
             color = reorder(model, n_params))) +
  geom_jitter(size = 5, alpha = .7, width = .05) +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(4, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) + 
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "Metric",
       y = "Mean Deriv. Step (Log10)",
       color = "") 


df_onset_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(model, n_params),
             y = m_onset,
             color = metric)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 5, alpha = .7, width = .05) +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(2, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) + 
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "Model",
       y = "Mean Deriv. Step (Log10)",
       color = "Metric") 


mod_full = lmer(data = df_onset_long,
                 log10(m_onset) ~ log10(n_params) * metric + 
                  (1  |seed_name) + (1|model))
summary(mod_full)


offsets = df_onset_long %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(model, seed_name, n_params),
              values_from = m_onset,
              names_from = metric) %>%
  mutate(temporal_offset = `Induction (PS)` - `1-back Attention`) %>%
  mutate(one_back_before = temporal_offset > 0)
mean(offsets$one_back_before)

summary(offsets$temporal_offset)

```
